tasks.label: Dev: Maybe build API image
tasks.command: $ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'; $timeoutSeconds = 3; Write-Host "Build API image before debug? [Y/n] Default: Y in $timeoutSeconds seconds"; $choice = $null; $deadline = (Get-Date).AddSeconds($timeoutSeconds); while ((Get-Date) -lt $deadline -and $null -eq $choice) { try { if ([Console]::KeyAvailable) { $choice = [Console]::ReadKey($true).KeyChar } } catch { break }; Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 100 }; if ($choice -eq 'n' -or $choice -eq 'N') { Write-Host 'Skipping API image build.' } else { docker-compose build xarchiver }

windows.command: $ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'; $timeoutSeconds = 3; Write-Host "Build API image before debug? [Y/n] Default: Y in $timeoutSeconds seconds"; $choice = $null; $deadline = (Get-Date).AddSeconds($timeoutSeconds); while ((Get-Date) -lt $deadline -and $null -eq $choice) { try { if ([Console]::KeyAvailable) { $choice = [Console]::ReadKey($true).KeyChar } } catch { break }; Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 100 }; if ($choice -eq 'n' -or $choice -eq 'N') { Write-Host 'Skipping API image build.' } else { docker-compose build xarchiver }

osx.command: bash -lc 'echo "Build API image before debug? [Y/n] Default: Y in 3 seconds"; if read -r -n 1 -t 3 choice; then echo; else choice=""; echo; fi; case "$choice" in n|N) echo "Skipping API image build." ;; *) docker-compose build xarchiver ;; esac'

linux.command: bash -lc 'echo "Build API image before debug? [Y/n] Default: Y in 3 seconds"; if read -r -n 1 -t 3 choice; then echo; else choice=""; echo; fi; case "$choice" in n|N) echo "Skipping API image build." ;; *) docker-compose build xarchiver ;; esac'

tasks.label: Dev: API debug container
tasks.command: docker-compose run --rm --service-ports --entrypoint python xarchiver -m debugpy --listen 0.0.0.0:5678 -m xarchiver.cli serve --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000
